version.changelog: Sync model list with live API: 28 supported image models (adds imagen-4-*, gpt-image-2(-eco), mj-v6.1/v6/niji6, wanx2.1-imageedit, flux-kontext-max; drops seedream-5.0, wan2.7-image(-pro), qwen-image-2.0(-pro)).

llm.summary: This is a straightforward Pixmind image generation skill that uses a declared API key and sends user-provided prompts or image URLs to Pixmind as expected.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is text-to-image and image-to-image generation, and the artifacts only implement prompt submission and task status polling for that workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to user-directed image generation, include prompt confirmation before generating, and do not contain hidden agent-control, unrelated automation, or destructive behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a SKILL.md plus two small Node helper scripts; metadata declares PIXMIND_API_KEY as the required environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads PIXMIND_API_KEY and contacts Pixmind API/CDN infrastructure; that is proportionate for an external image-generation integration, but users should understand content is processed off-device.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background installation, privilege escalation, local file indexing, credential-store access, package installation, or filesystem mutation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending prompts, generation settings, and any reference image URLs to Pixmind using your PIXMIND_API_KEY. Avoid confidential, regulated, proprietary, internal, or signed image URLs unless Pixmind's terms and data handling are acceptable for your use case.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The API key and outbound requests are expected for Pixmind integration. The required env var is declared in metadata and the API endpoint/auth header are documented, so this is not a material Review concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Prompts and reference image URLs are sent to Pixmind as part of the core function. The documentation identifies the external endpoint and CDN, though a stronger privacy notice would be useful user-facing guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: The helper script forwards --image URLs only when the user supplies them for img2img. The behavior is purpose-aligned and visible in the CLI option, but users should avoid internal, signed, or sensitive URLs.
